name: Painful Suggestion Trap AP OLD
description: A hidden rune on the floor under the filth, just past the threshold, triggers an ersatz ghost.
disable: DC 28 Thievery (expert) to remove the rune without triggering it, or Dispel Magic (4th rank; counteract DC 26) to dispel the rune

generalAbilities.name: Counterfeit Haunting
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A living creature moves over the rune

Effect A frightful moan echoes through the room, and a hoarse telepathic voice shouts, "Get out!"

This shout deals 6d12 Mental Damage damage to creatures in the room (Basic DC 26 Will Saving Throw save). Creatures who fail this saving throw must immediately leave the room and can't willingly reenter it for 1 minute (1 hour on a critical failure).
